scope: Unrestricted IsPacking consequences and a complete direction-independent closed-cell center cover.
facts: Every pair of distinct square centers has squared Euclidean separation at least one.
For L<=Cantrell37.upper, all centers are covered by 8x8 closed cells of width 7/10 starting at 1/2. All cell boundaries are included.
Each closed cell has capacity one because its squared diameter is 98/100<1.
There exists an injective assignment Fin n -> Fin 8 x Fin 8 preserving cell membership.
The cardinality consequence n<=64 is unconditional in orientation/contact structure, but is not an exclusion of n=37.
remaining: No exhaustive classification or exclusion of the possible occupied 37-cell subsets is supplied in these modules.
